title: Astronauts Return After Seven Months in Space
paragraphs: The four members of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission are back on Earth after 237 days in orbit. Their Crew Dragon spacecraft, Freedom, splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Los Angeles on 8 October 2026.

The crew launched in February and spent more than seven months on the International Space Station. During that time they travelled more than 160 million kilometres and circled the Earth more than 3,792 times. The team included NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, Sophie Adenot of the European Space Agency and Andrey Fedyaev of the Russian space agency Roscosmos.

The astronauts spent hundreds of hours on experiments, including the production of stem cells for medical treatments and a study of how bacteria that cause pneumonia may affect the heart. Meir completed four spacewalks, and Adenot completed three, becoming the first French woman to work outside the station. For Hathaway and Adenot, it was their first flight.
